# Inter Hospital Variation

This folder contains topics related to disparities and variations in clinical practices across different healthcare institutions. Currently, it holds a single page detailing significant differences in regional pain management protocols, specifically highlighting the unequal availability of epidural catheter treatments at facilities such as Amager og Hvidovre Hospital and Næstved, Slagelse og Ringsted sygehuse. 

## Pages

- [[inter-hospital-variation|Inter Hospital Variation]] — Details disparities in regional pain management protocols, specifically highlighting differences between hospitals in offering epidural catheter treatments.
